recommended_version.description: Below this version the optional «تحديث جديد متاح» sheet is offered (once per version, then every 3 days). Raise it only once the build is live on that store.

min_supported_version.description: Below this version «يلزم تحديث مشكاة» covers the app: sync, the account and reminder changes stop. 0.0.0 = never. Raise it only once the build is live on that store.

release_notes.description: Notes for the update sheet: {"version": "1.1.0", "notes": [{"icon": "bell", "ar": "…", "en": "…"}]}. Shown only when version equals recommended_version. icon is an MIcon name.

update_allow_reading.description: Offers «متابعة القراءة فقط» behind the required-update screen.
